records.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence. Sally assisted me in buying my _____ yesterday.
records.explanation: Very intensifies first; the ordinal phrase very first comes before party dress.

records.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence. Women always ______ themselves in beautiful apparel.
records.explanation: Adorn means decorate oneself, which fits beautiful clothing. Mar means spoil; trim means cut/neaten; garnish normally concerns decorating food, not dressing oneself.

records.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence. The man is not as powerful as he once was, his influence has considerably _______
records.explanation: Diminished means decreased; his reduced power is explained by declining influence.

records.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence. I can't lend him my books. I ______ know him.
records.explanation: Scarcely know means hardly know at all, explaining the refusal to lend books.

records.question: In each of the following questions, choose the option that has the same consonant sound as the one represented by the letter(s) underlined. Gap Target: the final p in Gap.
records.explanation: The underlined final p in gap is /p/, the initial consonant in pain.

records.question: In each of the following questions, choose the option opposite in meaning to the word or phrase underlined. The instructions given to him are vague . Target: word vague.
records.explanation: Vague instructions lack clarity; clear is their direct opposite. Obscure and hazy have similar meanings to vague; sure expresses certainty rather than clarity of instructions.

records.question: In each of the following questions, choose the option opposite in meaning to the word or phrase underlined. Due to old age, mother has become taciturn . Target: word taciturn.
records.explanation: Taciturn means habitually quiet; garrulous means excessively talkative.

records.question: In each of the following questions, choose the option opposite in meaning to the word or phrase underlined. She remembered how reticent her father had been about his past. Target: word reticent.
records.explanation: Reticent about the past means unwilling to reveal it; forthcoming means willing to supply information.

records.question: In each of the following questions, choose the option nearest in meaning to the word or phrase underlined. Unemployment among school leavers has reached epidemic proportions. Target: word epidemic.
records.explanation: Epidemic proportions figuratively means a widespread, extensive scale of unemployment.

records.question: In each of the following questions, select the option that best completes the gap. He went ____ the corridor, looking for the principal's office.
records.explanation: Along the corridor describes movement following its length. Under means beneath; among is used for surrounding distinct members; around would mean circling rather than going through the corridor.

records.question: In each of the following questions, choose the option that rhymes with the given word. Light
records.explanation: Light and right share /aɪt/, so their stressed vowel and following consonants rhyme.

records.question: In each of the following questions, choose the option that has the same vowel sounds as the one represented by the letter(s) underlined. Market Target: the e in Market.
records.explanation: The underlined e in market is /ɪ/ in standard British /ˈmɑːkɪt/; hymn also has /ɪ/.

records.question: In the following question, choose the option that has the same vowel sound as the one represented by the letter(s) underlined. bathe Target: the a in bathe.
records.explanation: Bathe has /eɪ/; rake has the same vowel. Bath has /ɑː/ in standard British English and care has /eə/. Tear can mean ripping (/teə/) or a drop from the eye (/tɪə/); neither has the /eɪ/ vowel in bathe.

records.question: In each of the following questions, choose the most appropriate stress pattern from the options. The stressed syllable is written in capital letters. immunity
records.explanation: Immunity has primary stress on its second syllable, mu: /ɪˈmjuːnəti/.

records.question: In each of the following questions, choose the most appropriate stress pattern from the options. The stressed syllable is written in capital letters. radioactive
records.explanation: Radioactive has primary stress on ac: /ˌreɪdiəʊˈæktɪv/. The earlier radio portion has secondary stress.

records.question: Select the option that best explains the information conveyed in the sentence. It is highly improbable that it will snow in June.
choices: It is highly unlikely that it will snow in June
It is possible that it will snow in June
It will never snow in June
The snowfall will probably be high in June

observed_options.A: It is highly unlikely that it will snow in June
observed_options.B: It is possible that it will snow in June
observed_options.C: It will never snow in June
observed_options.D: The snowfall will probably be high in June

records.explanation: Highly improbable means highly unlikely, without asserting absolute impossibility.

records.question: Select the option that best explains the information conveyed in the sentence. He played his wife false by inviting his mistress to the house as his cousin.
choices: he brought his cousin to his wife's room
His cousin and his wife were friends
He cheated on his wife with his mistress
He helped his wife with his mistress

observed_options.A: he brought his cousin to his wife's room
observed_options.B: His cousin and his wife were friends
observed_options.C: He cheated on his wife with his mistress
observed_options.D: He helped his wife with his mistress

records.explanation: Play someone false means betray or deceive them; presenting a mistress as a cousin describes cheating on his wife.

scope: Seventeen independently reviewed complete standalone publisher-labelled 2024 questions selected from the separately retained 65-item inventory; excluded/previously owned inventory is not an import batch.
